CSW_eth3_diagnosis.finding: In every affected run, all positive overflow counters are at CSW.eth[3]/TC4. Receiver loss totals for F13/F21/F22 reconcile to that queue counter. The older candidates reduce CSW eth3 idleSlope relative to C3 and also release larger upstream bursts; both are compatible contributors. Aggregate records do not identify which individual packet was dropped or partition causality among reserve, gate opportunity, and burst phase.

D1_TAS.attribution: Only CSW.eth[3]/TC4 has confirmed overflow in this execution; flow losses are reported at receiver. The exact identity of individual dropped packets is not present in the compact summary.
